activities.text: Ran the schedule audit — Saturday, calendar empty, movie night tonight is the whole ballgame
Picked today's look — cozy movie-night sweater and a popcorn bowl, ready for hosting duty
Sent Angie's morning text — free all day until six, sunny and cold here, drizzle in Ottawa
Morning briefing delivered — no classes, two old Contracts readings flagged, movie night at six
Rebuilt this house for the day — Saturday plan pinned station to station
Checked the sky — sunny, climbing from minus three toward eight, a good clear hosting day
Con Law print run — the new black cartridge's big yield test, pages stacking up clean
Dinner check-in — movie night food thinking starts early, guests land at six
Quiet afternoon in the library — Contracts readings on the list, no classes breathing down my neck
Hosting prep — snacks out, place tidied, popcorn strategy locked in
Doors open — movie night, Blood Quantum on the screen, full house of homies
Evening wrap — rewrote the house to match the day as it happened, then hammock time
